promptSpecification.assetType: production background texture atlas for a fictional Russian used-car browser game
promptSpecification.layout: Exactly five columns and five rows, equal rectangular tiles, no margins, no labels, no text, no borders
promptSpecification.composition: Each tile is a different empty street-side parking location, 35mm lens at car headlight height. Bottom 55% unobstructed level parking ground for inserting a vehicle; buildings and city context in upper 45%; no vehicles or people in foreground. Soft natural overcast daylight. Evocative fictional settings, not documentary reconstructions.
